title: Ɔhokafoɔ a Ɔdanee ne ho
intro: Worebɛda ɔkra bi a ɔtenaa nkɔmhyɛni sunsuma mu nanso ɔpaw ɔkwan bi a ɛde kɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu ho asɛm. Saa akontabuo yi ne Allah abɔfoɔ a wapaw wɔn no mu baako kyɛ fie nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ gyidie sɔhwɛ no mu. Hena ne ɔhokafo a wayera yi?
clues: Metenaa nnipa a wɔpoo ɔfrɛ a wɔde kɔ tenenee mu no mu, na mansɔre ntia wɔn.
Na mewaree Allah diyifo bi, nanso na menni gyidie no bi.
Bere a abɔfo no de kɔkɔbɔ baa me fie no, mannye wɔn anni.
Wɔhyɛɛ me hokafoɔ sɛ ɔne agyidifoɔ no mfi kuro no mu, na menni wɔn mu.
Asotwe no sian baa me nkurɔfo so, na wɔsɛee me ne wɔn.
Wɔaka me ho asɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu sɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa gyidie a wonni ho, ka Nuh yere ho, wɔ Surah At-Tahrim mu.

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔde no kɔɔ nnommumfa mu kɔɔ akyirikyiri asase bi so
Onu ne ho na wɔde kyɛɛ no

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
